Bleed Amplification.note:
Bleed Amplification:
Makes enemies take x5 bleed damage for the duration of the effect.

Slow.note:
Slow:
The speed of enemies is reduced for the duration of the effect.

Stun.note:
Stun:
Freezes enemies for the duration of the effect.

Confused.note:
Confused:
Makes all enemies in range walk backwards for 5 seconds.

Freeze.note:
Freeze:
Freezes enemies for the duration of the effect (Has a cooldown of 10-12 seconds).

Conflicts with [[Lulu (Geass)|Confusion]] ability (by [[Lulu (Geass)|Lulu]]), and other users dealing Freeze/Timestop.

Timestop.note:
Timestop:
Freezes enemy for duration of the effect (Has a cooldown of 10-12 seconds).

Conflicts with [[Lulu (Geass)|Confusion]] ability (by [[Lulu (Geass)|Lulu]]), and other users dealing Freeze/Timestop.

Dismembered.note:
Dismembered:
Brutally removes a random limb from the enemy and causes the enemy to take 20% more {{Tower_Infobox/Damage_type|physical}} damage permanently (does not stack)

Motivate.note:
Motivate:
Each attack buffs all allies in range by 15% damage or 10% range for 10 seconds, same effects do not stack.

Battlelust.note:
Battlelust:
Each attack increases damage by 5% up to 25% as long as the unit has a target.

Shatter.note:
Shatter:
Removes all shield instances on enemies when hit.

Snatched.note:
Snatched:
Each attack increases damage by 3% up to 33% (99% on a max upgrade) for 90 seconds.

Mind Control.note:
Walk Back:
Forces enemies with a 10% chance in range to walk back for 1.5 seconds.

Hexed (20%).note:
Hexed:
Curses enemy and debuffs which causes the enemy to take 30% more {{Tower_Infobox/Damage_type|magic}} damage permanently (does not stack)

Hexed (25%).note:
Hexed:
Curses enemy and debuffs which causes the enemy to take 30% more {{Tower_Infobox/Damage_type|magic}} damage permanently (does not stack)

Sunshine.note:
Sunshine:
Damage and range increases every wave. Up to 15 waves. Receives 2.25x more damage and 1.67x range at maximum sunshine.

OverCrit.note:
OverCrit:
Guarantees a crit on enemies that are currently bleeding.

Wild Card.note: Applies fire, slow, bleed, freeze, or knockback randomly.
